_what: C-9 CRATER v4 (R-C9-109) behind ?meteor=mix4: the fall (dark fire-ball core) and A's painted burst UNCHANGED; the crater rebuilt in three layers the Barrow's way. drax.

layers.1_real_3d: tools/crater_mesh.py in Blender 5.2 (no vendor call): a 101x101 grid (4.2 cm), 20k tris: shallow bowl 0.22 m deep, a raised broken rim (noise lumps and gaps, up to 0.11 m), 7-9 radial fault-line fractures (Voronoi-seeded angles, wander with momentum, one branch each) cut as V-grooves, 1-2 runners across the skirt, a feathered skirt 1.3 R -> 1.9 R easing to level with vertex alpha -> 0; R = 1.1 m (MIX v3's footprint). 3 variants (seeds 11, 23, 37). Placed unrotated; drawn with a 0.4 m depth bias toward the orthographic camera (no screen shift) so the bowl wins against the snow it sits in while anyone standing in it still hides it; the snow is also pressed under it (SnowField._stamp)
layers.2_painted: each mesh rendered on the painted Barrow at the game camera as a greybox clay lit by the painting's sun with its cracks drawn (godot/tools/crater_guide.gd), ONE guided Astra EDIT paint-over in the Barrow's style with the local ground as context (tools/crater_briefs.py; the concept as IMAGE 2), projected back into the mesh's planar UVs through the camera (tools/crater_project.py: every UV texel's screen pixel from the grid's own projection; alignment checked by projecting the crack mask: exact). Unlit (static after impact). A separately PAINTED emission mask per variant (Astra EDIT over the paint, guided by the crack geometry), projected the same way; the shader drives it hot orange -> dull red -> dark over the fire field's life with a slow uneven pulse along the cracks. A random variant per impact, never rotated
layers.3_particles: embers: one GPUParticles3D with the kit's own painted ember sprite (C-7 cliffside fire_ending ember_1), additive, rising off the crater; smoke: one GPUParticles3D playing ONE new painted sheet (VF-crater-smoke-01: 8 frames of a thin wisp); debris: one MultiMesh of 28 lumps per crater (the ember sprite darkened as it cools), thrown at impact, landing on the snow and staying until the crater fades

timing.fire_field_life_s: (30 + 15 (level - 1)) / 25 -> 12.6 s at level 20 (D2 packet), a parameter (crater_v4_fx.fire_life_s)
timing.release_to_impact: a runtime parameter: default 0.82 s (Matt's approved speed); ?fall=2.4 (desktop -- --fall 2.4) shows the D2 packet's 2.4 s; the release comes from her clip at run time
timing.pool: 4 craters, the oldest fading over 1.5 s when the pool is full

astra.lane: codex exec gpt-6-astra (lane/run_burst.py), refs under runs/C-9/artifacts/inputs/

performance.rules: one shader per layer (skins: 4 materials of ONE shader; debris one shader; the particles two StandardMaterial3D), MultiMesh for debris, one particle system per kind, all built at load and drawn once under the veil (warmed; nothing created at cast time), pool 4, meshes never rebuilt at cast time (the MIX v3 lesson)

performance.note: the control's draw peak includes craters left by earlier casts (they live 12.6 s; casts are 6 s apart)
